title: CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout Generation in Aurantiochytrium limacinum
author: Anbarasu Karthikaichamy

Wear gloves and use nuclease-free tubes and reagents. Reactions should be assembled in microfuge tubes or PCR strip tubes. Perform gRNA synthesis following the EnGen®sgRNA Synthesis Kit . EnGen® sgRNA Synthesis Kit S. pyogenes New England Biolabs Catalog #E3322S

Thaw the gRNA and 1x PBS on ice. Spin down all the reagents before using. For a total reaction volume of 5μl, Add 120 pmol (final) gRNA and 104 pmol (final) Cas9 protein. Adjust the reaction volume to 5μl using 1x PBS. Cas9 Nuclease S. pyogenes New England Biolabs Catalog #M0386S Mix the reagents by gently pipetting up and down. After a brief spin, incubate the tube at Room temperature for 00:20:00 . Label and store the RNP (Cas9/gRNA) complex in -20 °C until further use. Optional Check the efficiency of RNP by performing an in vitro cleavage assay .

steps.title: Prepare pre‑culture of A. limacinum
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL GPY (0.5 % yeast extract, 1 % peptone, 3 % D‑+‑glucose, 1.8 % instant ocean) in a 15 mL tube with a colony and incubate overnight at 28 °C. Use this preculture to inoculate 46 mL GPY in a 250 mL flask and culture for 3 days at 28 °C, 171 rpm (total pre‑culture time ≈4 days).

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL GPY tube with colony; incubate overnight at 28 °C.
Transfer preculture to 46 mL GPY in 250 mL flask; culture 3 days at 28 °C, 171 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare media, plates, and buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare GPYs liquid medium (3 % glucose, 0.6 % peptone, 0.2 % yeast extract, 50 mM sucrose, 1.8 % instant ocean). Make GPYs agar plates (2 % agar) supplemented with ampicillin (100 µg mL⁻¹) or with zeocin (100 µg mL⁻¹) plus ampicillin (100 µg mL⁻¹) for HDR experiments. Prepare 1× BSS (10 mM KCl, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM CaCl₂) and a 50 mM sucrose solution. Sterilize all by autoclave or filter as appropriate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare GPYs liquid medium with listed components.
Prepare GPYs agar plates with 2 % agar and 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin.
Prepare GPYs agar plates with 2 % agar, 100 µg mL⁻¹ zeocin and 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin (for HDR).
Prepare 1× BSS buffer (10 mM KCl, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM CaCl₂).
Sterilize all solutions/plates by autoclave or filtration.

steps.title: Design and order gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Use the ChopChop web tool with the A. limacinum genome (JGI assembly) to identify candidate gRNAs at the target locus (e.g., scaffold_10:1222284‑1223740 (+)). Select a top‑ranked guide, then prepend the T7 promoter sequence (TTCTAATACGACTCACTATA) to the 5′ end and append the 14‑nt overlap (GTTTTAGAGCTAGA) to the 3′ end, yielding a final oligo of the form 5′‑TTCTAATACGACTCACTATA‑N₍₂₀₎‑GTTTTAGAGCTAGA‑3′. Order the oligo for in‑vitro transcription (start the pre‑culture while the oligo is being shipped).

steps.title: Synthesize, purify, and store gRNA
steps.instruction: Transcribe the ordered oligo to RNA, then purify the gRNA using the Monarch RNA Cleanup Kit (50 µg, NEB catalog #T2050S). Quantify the purified gRNA with a UV‑Vis nano‑spectrophotometer. Store aliquots at –20 °C for short‑term or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells for electroporation
steps.instruction: Count cells with a haemocytometer and adjust to ~5 × 10⁷ cells mL⁻¹. Aliquot 1.5 mL of this suspension into a microcentrifuge tube per electroporation. Centrifuge 11 000 rpm, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant. Add 500 µL chilled 1× BSS, centrifuge as before, discard supernatant. Add 500 µL chilled 50 mM sucrose, centrifuge as before, discard supernatant. Repeat the BSS‑sucrose wash three times total. Resuspend the pellet by scraping the cell mass from the tube wall and vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Count cells; adjust to ~5 × 10⁷ cells mL⁻¹.
Add 1.5 mL cells to tube; centrifuge 11 000 rpm, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL chilled 1× BSS; centrifuge 11 000 rpm, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL chilled 50 mM sucrose; centrifuge 11 000 rpm, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant.
Repeat BSS‑sucrose wash three times total.
Resuspend pellet by scraping cell mass from tube wall and vortex.

steps.title: Add RNP complex and load cuvette
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the Cas9‑gRNA ribonucleoprotein (RNP) mixture to the washed cell suspension and incubate on ice for 5 min. Transfer the mixture to a chilled 0.2 cm Bio‑Rad electroporation cuvette kept on ice. Prepare a negative‑control cuvette with the same volume of elution buffer or water.

steps.title: Electroporate using NEPA21 settings
steps.instruction: Clean the NEPA21 loading pedestal and cuvette. Set the poring pulse to 205 V, 50 ms length, 140 ms interval (values taken from the protocol) and apply the transfer pulse parameters as indicated. Use a capacitance of 125 µF and a resistance of 1000 Ω. Deliver the pulses, record the time constant, then immediately place the cuvette on ice. Repeat for all samples.

steps.title: Recover cells in GPYs medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL GPYs medium to the cuvette, gently aspirate the cells into a fresh microcentrifuge tube, label the tube, and incubate at 28 °C for 1 h without shaking. Centrifuge at 11 000 rpm, 25 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant. Resuspend the pellet in the remaining supernatant by pipetting and vortexing. Dilute the suspension 100‑fold or 1000‑fold in 100 µL fresh GPYs medium, then plate on the appropriate GPYs agar plates (typically containing ampicillin). Incubate plates at 28 °C.

steps.title: Screen transformant colonies
steps.instruction: After 2 days of incubation, colonies will appear. Streak individual colonies onto fresh GPYs plates, include a wild‑type control, and assess phenotype (e.g., colony colour for carotenogenic gene knockout) and genotype as required. Use the appropriate selection marker (ampicillin, zeocin) according to the construct.
